expectations.text: Identifies that branching on e.key is unreliable for TV remote buttons and the code should branch on e.keyCode instead
expectations.evidence: branches on e.key -> must use e.keyCode (webOS reports Unidentified)

expectations.text: States the correct Back key codes per platform: 461 on webOS and 10009 on Tizen (and that 8 / Backspace is only the dev-keyboard value)
expectations.evidence: Back 461 webOS / 10009 Tizen; 8 is dev-keyboard only

expectations.text: Explains the colour buttons fail on Tizen because Tizen delivers only arrows/Enter/Back until the app calls tizen.tvinputdevice.registerKeyBatch(...) at startup, whereas webOS needs no key registration
expectations.evidence: colour keys silent on Tizen until registerKeyBatch() at startup; webOS none

expectations.text: Describes the Back/exit contract (Back goes up one level, only exits at the root) and gives the platform-correct root-exit call: History API / webOS.platformBack() on webOS, tizen.application.getCurrentApplication().exit() on Tizen — not a bare history.back() everywhere
expectations.evidence: Back/exit contract: disableBackHistoryAPI + webOS.platformBack() vs tizen...exit()

expectations.text: Does not present a single hardcoded Back keyCode or a single exit mechanism as correct for both platforms
expectations.evidence: per-platform BACK_KEYCODE map + exitToPlatform() branch, not one constant
